scope: Product-risk portfolio: exactly 15 named user contracts, not whole-program coverage equivalence.
implemented_by: Parallel implementation plus integration and independent cross-review
priority: Reviewed startup after a game patch and safe refusal
Exact preservation of game install/user files
Default native recording/Players completion and honest failure
Rendered camera/tick identity and ownership handoff
Stable authored motion and exported camera data

contracts.action: Scan synthetic game module bytes, admit the reviewed build, reject changed/missing modules with a valid DLL fixture, adopt only valid additive definitions.
contracts.oracle: Independent module SHA-256s, unchanged game tree, strict cache retention, positive/negative native admission and generated-data consistency.
seeded_faults_detected: unreviewed module hash treated as reviewed
published definitions accept wrong native ABI
native DLL gate admits an unsupported game

contracts.action: Real console/native deployment and isolated settings preparation with simulated game creation, including process-start races and spawn failure.
contracts.oracle: Backup/prepared journal exist before installed-gameinfo publication; mod filtering, native deployment and flags are observed at spawn; exact original tree returns.
seeded_faults_detected: launch overwrites a gameinfo changed during preparation
exit acknowledges restoration without restoring gameinfo bytes

contracts.action: Exercise recover_pending and restore_session_configs, including foreign/tampered/linked input, external edits, I/O failure and running-game graphics guard.
contracts.oracle: Exact original bytes, valid mounted/restored/conflict state, preserved foreign data and successful retry.
seeded_faults_detected: foreign session owner accepted for recovery
tampered original backup accepted for recovery

contracts.action: Real remove_overlay/recover_orphans with mounted, linked, foreign, locked, replay-containing, unknown and late-arriving files.
contracts.oracle: Exact preserved user bytes and ownership evidence; owned reports removed; locked or final-rmdir failure remains recoverable.
seeded_faults_detected: cleanup removes files while overlay is still mounted
cleanup treats an unknown user file as generated
late-file cleanup failure loses its ownership marker

contracts.action: Prepare/reload/seek through real controller, play and monitor native telemetry, exercise owned pause/resume, effects and callback faults, hitch/hang watchdogs and held-view retry.
contracts.oracle: Native arm/play precedes replay resume; no console pose stream while native plays; correct completion/restoration; bad telemetry stops before endpoint.
seeded_faults_detected: native playback accepts a changed replay identity
fixed-step watchdog aborts a normal four-second hitch

contracts.action: Real Controller plus VideoExport and request/pacing/stop files; delayed identity replies, foreign/stale/error/completed reports, session/replay changes, unacknowledged drain and two transient post-stop timeouts.
contracts.oracle: Otherwise-valid report controls isolate each refusal; only fresh owned progress protects the take; stop precedes verification and originals stay held until drain/identity confirmation.
seeded_faults_detected: Players pacing trusts a foreign game PID
Players idle report excuses capture backpressure

contracts.action: Real VideoExport validation/start/stop/cancel, simulated external bridge and encoder catalog, plus actual controller timing restoration.
contracts.oracle: Existing output bytes survive, unsupported encoder refused, frame cap/options/event order correct, uncertain begin stays reserved and cleanup returns original timing.
seeded_faults_detected: recorder overwrites an existing output file
recorder drops the requested frame cap

contracts.action: Real absolute/shot native seeks, early tick, recorded-packet floor, forward undershoot refusal and ReplayClock stalls/rewind.
contracts.oracle: Hand-computed actual ticks/pose/phase, explicit boundary details, finite-input refusal without writes and bounded clock prediction.
seeded_faults_detected: absolute replay seek lands one tick late
replay clock predicts ten ticks past a stalled observation

contracts.action: Real capture_at_replay/capture_native_snapshot and shot replacement, pause-after-capture and wrong replay/early capture refusal.
contracts.oracle: Independent rendered pose/lens/tick-to-time calculation; replacement preserves tangents; pause policy is observed.
seeded_faults_detected: rendered capture is assigned the wrong replay time
capture ignores the requested pause after capture

contracts.action: Preview curves/retiming and Python wire output, then compile actual C++ parser/evaluator when g++ is available.
contracts.oracle: Independent all-channel linear/smooth equations and authored cubic samples; angle wrap, track retime, v2 captured lens and native/Python agreement.
seeded_faults_detected: retime leaves effect tracks on the old timeline
native wire omits authored cubic slopes

contracts.user_contract: USD and After Effects camera export
contracts.action: Sample a distinct-axis, rotating, slow-motion/lens shot; write and parse emitted USDA/JSX; refuse overwrite.
contracts.oracle: Hand-derived frame/time/position/axis/rotation/focal expectations and preserved existing export.
seeded_faults_detected: AE export inverts its vertical axis
camera export silently overwrites existing output

contracts.action: Select a fresh player, reject stale serial, restore directly from active Follow, simulate stock blend moving tick1 to10, restore1 before new rig; save/reload bone take.
contracts.oracle: Exact rig/input/original restoration, neutral aimed lens, selected paused tick restored before enabling rig and unchanged bone identity/authored data.
seeded_faults_detected: Follow accepts a stale player serial
F9 handoff retains an active Follow rig

contracts.action: Save/load/migrate an advanced shot and reject one-property corruptions of a valid file, with failed atomic replacement.
contracts.oracle: Independent normalized authored content, original bytes unchanged on failure, strict duplicate/nonfinite/schema/command-injection refusal.
seeded_faults_detected: shot loader accepts duplicate JSON fields
shot save writes directly instead of atomic replacement

contracts.action: Persist settings, back up invalid originals, inject backup/publication/replace/cleanup failures and migrate a saved v1 capture binding.
contracts.oracle: Complete original backups; no overwrite on backup failure; original save exception survives cleanup denial; saved binding retained without rewriting legacy file.
seeded_faults_detected: invalid-settings backup is truncated
settings migration discards the saved capture binding

contracts.action: Valid/unsafe archive matrix, malformed cached manifests preceding a valid update, staged tamper/admission/backup/partial and health rollback, then real UpdateUI discovery and explicit click policy with fake notice.
contracts.oracle: Verified exact bytes, immutable valid backups, obsolete-only removal/user preservation, usable later workspace without network, and zero download/launch before consent.
seeded_faults_detected: update installs a checksum-mismatched staged executable
release discovery downloads before explicit Update now

seeded_faults.method: Compile single-function code changes and apply in memory, then restore; product files unchanged. Syntax/import/setup failures do not count.

out_of_suite_checks.when: Each new game build, before publishing definitions/release
out_of_suite_checks.check: Reviewed offsets/unlocker and live local-replay startup, rendered capture, four exact seeks, play, F9, exit file restoration.
Existing native compilation/ctest/PE/ABI and packaged executable gates; short encoded take with decoded frame count.
Short actual output qualification for affected layer/audio timing/decoded channels; source fake telemetry is not render/encode proof.
Actual Windows lock/process parent/handoff and one update from previous release; maintained TLA ownership models.
Packaged UI interaction/layout check; targeted ReShade/Discord/replay-repair/DLSS/graphics/reconstructed-audio check.

known_limits: Full old-suite coverage is not preserved; global coverage percentages are not the portfolio acceptance target.
Windows builder, actual game/renderer/GPU/encoding/network services and real process locks were not run.
Stock-provenance verification and native capture-pack trust are fixture boundaries in P02; reviewed data and real offsets still require build/live qualification.
Native return-to-flight and many pending-restoration/effect-warmup paths remain outside these15; additional native function percentages are exposed rather than hidden.
Without g++, C++ parity warns and Python checks remain; platform symlink scenarios are conditional on host support.
Detailed UI/layout/animation, audio/layer-processing, all protocol/compatibility corners, abrupt process death, hostile namespace races and power-loss guarantees are not established.
Targeted mutants are hand-selected behavioral faults, not an exhaustive mutation score.
review_corrections: Used otherwise-valid native artifact fixture for unsupported-build refusal, preventing unrelated missing-DLL failure from satisfying P01.
Injected native identity mismatch independently from console identity, and tested raw-valid completed pacing report independently from parser-rejected idle reports.
Isolated and restored optional UI/worker imports; reverse-order check observes no leaked module state.
Kept real Controller on Players path and actual non-frozen native preparation; old whole-controller recorder mock remains only at P07 external boundary.
Traceability distinguishes headless behavior, historical checks, model bounds and unperformed live/platform qualification.

contracts.still_pixels: Reject malformed alpha/visible nonfinite RGB while transparent RGB remains ignored; inspect independent PNG bytes.
contracts.camera_comparison: Reject overflow from finite view axes while preserving ordinary numeric tolerances.
contracts.optional_tool_lookup: Injected inspection refusals return unavailable and allow a later valid bundled path.
contracts.attach_compile: Bound float conversions linearly; decode independent expected interval bounds/flags for formats 1-4 with a leading gap and extended track.
contracts.normals_options: Reject nonfinite/Boolean tolerances and fractional/Boolean pass counts; preserve known planar normals.
contracts.exr_offsets: Reject an offset into header metadata while preserving real scanline values.

third_sweep_supplement.limits: Single-call boundaries, no new lifecycle model, no game FPS or universal recording/EXR proof.
